primitives.name: Cold Open Retirement
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Flagship 2026 — R2 Visual QA Checklist Manual + automated QA for the R2 concision rebuild.
primitives.assumptions: The UI must transition from a slow doctrine intro to a data-first presentation without redundant narrative layers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When legacy narrative elements persist beyond UI concision thresholds.

layer2.mapping: The cold open retirement maps to a signal degradation model where narrative entropy is minimized through automated QA enforcement.
layer2.telemetry: Test suite compliance rate for doctrine hero removal.

primitives.name: Navigation Route Integrity
primitives.verbatim_quote: - [ ] Players opens the lab directly (no lens dropdown in the bar).
primitives.assumptions: All navigation paths must be deterministic and consistent across device types.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When route ambiguity or dead links occur due to inconsistent URL handling.

layer2.mapping: Nav integrity is modeled as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of URL states with terminal nodes representing valid UI endpoints.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of resolved navigation paths without dead links.

primitives.name: Reduced Motion Handling
primitives.verbatim_quote: - [ ] With OS "reduce motion" on: no montage, lands straight on the page.
primitives.assumptions: Motion-based UI components must gracefully degrade to static layouts under system-level motion preferences.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when animated transitions override OS-level accessibility settings.

layer2.mapping: Reduced motion handling mirrors a control-theoretic feedback loop where system preference overrides UI animation parameters.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of pages rendered without motion artifacts under reduced motion flag.
